_comment: Expected AltDSS-schema divergences: fragments where the PORT's schema intentionally differs from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle because the port's engine adopted newer (dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133) behavior. Each entry is a `port_extra_line` the port emits that the 0.14.5 oracle does not; golden_schema.rs removes exactly `count` occurrences from the port's rendered class def before byte-comparing against the oracle golden, and FAILS if the count no longer matches (stale entry) or an unexplained diff remains. Only documented upstream causes are admissible here — this is NOT a tolerance. Regenerate the oracle side via tools/golden/gen_schema.py.

divergences.cause: dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 flags LineCode FaultRate/PctPerm/Repair as Deprecated+Unused (a LineCode never propagated them to its Lines; unused in the engine since 2014). The port follows the newer engine (UPGRADE WP-U1.4, prop_flags.rs::DEPRECATED), so its schema emits `deprecated: true`; the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates the flag and omits it.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 adds CNData.SemiconLayer (CNData.pas, `SemiconLayer = 5`): existence of a semicon layer between insulation and the concentric-neutral strands, affecting shunt self-admittances. The port adopted it (conductor_data/cn_data.rs, UPGRADE_PLAN.md WP-U1.4); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 backend (CNData `TProp` ends at RStrand=4) has no such property, so it is inserted at ordinal 5, shifting every following $dssPropertyIndex/$dssPropertyOrder down by one vs the oracle.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 adds the LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): Detailed selects per-conductor coordinates (x/h arrays) vs the four equivalent-distance fields. The port adopted it (line_spacing/mod.rs, UPGRADE_PLAN.md WP-U1.4); pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 (LineSpacing `TProp` ends at units=5) lacks it.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): geometric-mean distance between phase conductors. Port-adopted (line_spacing/mod.rs, UPGRADE WP-U1.4); absent from pinned dss_capi 0.14.5.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): geometric-mean distance between phase and neutral conductors. Port-adopted (line_spacing/mod.rs, UPGRADE WP-U1.4); absent from pinned dss_capi 0.14.5.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): average height of phase conductors. Port-adopted (line_spacing/mod.rs, UPGRADE WP-U1.4); absent from pinned dss_capi 0.14.5.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): average height of neutral conductors. Port-adopted (line_spacing/mod.rs, UPGRADE WP-U1.4); absent from pinned dss_capi 0.14.5.

The vendored dss_capi snapshot (newer than the pinned 0.14.5 oracle backend) adds Units_kvar to Capacitor.kvar — dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' (verified: 0.14.5 tag has `[RequiredInSpecSet]`, the vendored .inputs/dss_capi has `[RequiredInSpecSet, Units_kvar]`). The port follows the vendored spec, so its schema emits `units: kvar`; the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates it. (Reactor.kvar's Units_kvar predates 0.14.5, so its `units: kvar` is byte-exact — this diff is Capacitor-specific.)

OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data: Transformer BHpoints/BHcurrent/BHflux, inserted after Ratings (ordinal 49) before the inherited PD/CktElement tail. The port carries them as SUPPRESS_JSON forward-compat parse targets (transformer/mod.rs), so they render no schema block but occupy $dssPropertyIndex 50-52, shifting every following prop's index +3 vs the 0.14.5 oracle (whose Transformer TProp ends at Ratings=49). $dssPropertyOrder is unaffected (SUPPRESS_JSON excludes them from AltPropertyOrder).
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the BHPoints entry): Transformer BHcurrent, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 51, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the BHPoints entry): Transformer BHflux, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 52, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.

OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) replaced RegControl's kWRevPowerThreshold field (+100 kW default) with a signed RevPowerThreshold (W) field, Units_kW + PropertyScale 1000, defaulting to -100000 W = -100 kW (reg_control/mod.rs). The port adopted r4086, so its RevThreshold default is -100; the pinned 0.14.5 oracle emits +100.

OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) added RegControl idle-zone flags. Idle suppresses tap changes inside a power dead-band (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle (whose RegControl TProp ends at Cogen=32).
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) RegControl idle-zone flag IdleReverse (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) RegControl idle-zone flag IdleForward (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) added RegControl's forward-power threshold FwdPowerThreshold (W), Units_kW + scale 1000, default 100 kW (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.

dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' adds Units_kW to Generator.kW ([RequiredInSpecSet] -> [RequiredInSpecSet, Units_kW]); the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates it and omits the unit. The port follows the vendored source (generator/mod.rs). kW appears in both spec sets ('kW, pf' and 'kW, kvar'), so the line renders twice in the oneOf. (Same 'More units' wave as the Capacitor.kvar divergence.)

dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' adds Units_kvar to Generator.kvar ([NoDefault, RequiredInSpecSet] -> [+ Units_kvar]); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 backend predates it. The port follows the vendored source (generator/mod.rs). kvar appears only in the 'kW, kvar' spec set, so the line renders once in the oneOf.

divergences.from:
"default" : "none",
      "description" : "Name of the TCC Curve object that determines the fuse blowing.  Must have been previously defined as a TCC_Curve object or specified as \"none\" (ignored). If \"none\", fuse sampling will be skipped and device will not blow for any current level. Default is \"none\". Multiplying the current values in the curve by the \"CurveMultiplier\" value gives the actual current.",
divergences.to:
"default" : "tlink",
      "description" : "Name of the TCC Curve object that determines the fuse blowing.  Must have been previously defined as a TCC_Curve object. Default is \"Tlink\". Multiplying the current values in the curve by the \"RatedCurrent\" value gives the actual current.",
divergences.cause: OpenDSS r4133 (WP-U2.1, Version8 Controls/fuse.pas) repurposed the Fuse TCC model: FuseCurve defaults to "none" (was "Tlink") and its help names "CurveMultiplier" as the divisor instead of "RatedCurrent". The port ported r4133 (elements/pd/fuse); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 oracle keeps the classic default/help.

divergences.from:
"default" : 0.0000000000000000E+000,
      "description" : "Fuse continuous rated current in Amps. Defaults to 0. Not used internally for either power flow or reporting.",
divergences.to:
"default" : 1.0000000000000000E+000,
      "description" : "Multiplier or actual phase amps for the phase TCC curve.  Defaults to 1.0.",
divergences.cause: OpenDSS r4133 (WP-U2.1, Version8 Controls/fuse.pas:393) repurposed Fuse.RatedCurrent from the TCC divisor (default 1.0, 'Multiplier or actual phase amps') to a purely informational continuous rating (default 0.0, 'Fuse continuous rated current in Amps'); the new CurveMultiplier prop took over the divisor role. The port ported r4133; the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 oracle keeps the old RatedCurrent semantics.

OpenDSS r4133 (WP-U2.1, Version8 Controls/fuse.pas:191 CurveMultiplier) added the Fuse TCC-curve current multiplier (GetTCCTime(Cmag/CurveMultiplier)), default 1.0, taking over the divisor role RatedCurrent had in 0.14.5. The port adopted it (elements/pd/fuse/mod.rs); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 oracle (Fuse TProp ends at State=10) lacks it, inserted at ordinal 11, shifting the following BaseFreq/Enabled/Like $dssPropertyIndex/$dssPropertyOrder down.

OpenDSS r4133 (WP-U2.1, Version8 Controls/fuse.pas:192 InterruptingRating) added the informational Fuse rated interrupting current (default 0.0, not used internally). The port adopted it (elements/pd/fuse/mod.rs); absent from the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 oracle, inserted at ordinal 12.
